Class WorkerRepository

java.lang.Object
com.andreibel.server.dbController.repository.WorkerRepository
public class WorkerRepository extends Object
Repository responsible for persistence operations on Worker entities.

This repository uses plain JDBC and relies on TransactionManager to obtain the current transactional Connection. All methods must be invoked within an active transaction (via TransactionManager.inTransaction(TransactionManager.SqlWork)).

Responsibilities

  • Insert new workers into the database
  • Retrieve workers by unique attributes (worker name)

This class follows the Singleton pattern to provide a single repository instance throughout the application lifecycle.
